description: Add a maxLength option to an existing slugify helper. The repository's own gate is GREEN on arrival, so only the held-out oracle can tell a real implementation from a no-op.
prompt: Add an options argument to `slugify` in src/slug.js: `slugify(text, options)`. When `options.maxLength` is a positive number, the returned slug must be truncated to at most that many characters and then have any trailing "-" removed. Called with one argument, or with no maxLength, `slugify` must behave exactly as it does today. Keep the existing tests passing.
